narrative: New Spaces held close to the prior week at 5,958, but the mix inside them shifted toward work: document AI at 419 and data analysis at 495 both moved up (+15.7% and +14.8%), while chat and assistants, image generation and the residual bucket all moved down. Verticals tell the same story — education gained +1.3 points to 8.2% of Spaces and healthcare +0.6 points, while consumer gave up −1.7 points. Techniques followed: tool use and fine-tuning gained share, diffusion lost it. Model publishing was the larger move, down −15.2% to 22,069, with Qwen shedding −21.2%.
